GAP-FILL: dashboard visual verification and orphaned-duplicates denylist refinement

- scripts/run-founder-ui-login-e2e.mjs: extends the credentialed founder UI E2E to cross-check the live dashboard DOM against the same APIs the page calls (Point B strip + scoreboard tiles inside the lifeos-dashboard.html iframe).
- scripts/check-orphaned-duplicates.mjs: refined NAME_DENYLIST to exclude internal markers and shared constants that collide legitimately (__private__, DEFAULT_LEDGER_PATH, DASHBOARD_HTML_TARGET), reducing advisory noise from 47 to 44 findings.
- docs/products/lifeos/PRODUCT_HOME.md: top-inserted change receipt and updated Last Updated.
- products/receipts/FOUNDER_UI_LOGIN_E2E.json: fresh production run with dashboard.ok: true.

HAND-AUTHORED-JUSTIFICATION: Both .mjs files are orchestration/verification scripts, not new business logic under SO-001; they were edited in place with behavioral proof (node --check and a live production E2E pass) rather than generated through the governed factory.
Co-Authored-By: Devin AI <158243242+devin-ai-integration[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
